test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Find the area of four walls of a cube, the length of whose edge is (3x + 8y + 5) m .
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Area of four walls** of a **cube** (Lateral Surface Area) = 4 × (side)².

Given side **a** = (3x + 8y + 5).

Using identity (a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2ab + 2bc + 2ca.

4 × [(3x)² + (8y)² + (5)² + 2(3x)(8y) + 2(8y)(5) + 2(5)(3x)]

4 × [9x² + 64y² + 25 + 48xy + 80y + 30x] = 36x² + 256y² + 100 + 192xy + 320y + 120x.

**∴ The correct answer is (36x² + 256y² + 100 + 192xy + 320y + 120x) m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Edge** of the cube (a) = (3x + 8y + 5) m.

**Formula Used:** Area of four walls (**LSA**) = 4a².

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a836530785e64dca9cde0d77fdfef007a108011a9f1f84e0dc2de077add661c3.png] 

⇒ Area = 4 × (3x + 8y + 5)²

⇒ Area = 4 × [(3x)² + (8y)² + (5)² + 2(3x)(8y) + 2(8y)(5) + 2(5)(3x)]

⇒ Area = 4 × [9x² + 64y² + 25 + 48xy + 80y + 30x]

⇒ Area = (4 × 9x²) + (4 × 64y²) + (4 × 25) + (4 × 48xy) + (4 × 80y) + (4 × 30x)

⇒ Area = 36x² + 256y² + 100 + 192xy + 320y + 120x

**∴ The correct answer is (36x² + 256y² + 100 + 192xy + 320y + 120x) m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cube

The total surface area includes all six faces and is given by 6a², where **a** is the edge length.

Volume of Cube

The space occupied by the cube is calculated using the formula **V** = a³.

Algebraic Identity

(a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2ab + 2bc + 2ca is essential for expanding polynomial side lengths.</p
